name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Recognition and holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople, including skill training, toolkit incentive and collateral-free credit.
benefit: Skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive and collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh

conditions.label: Must be an artisan or craftsperson in a traditional trade
Must be at least 18 years old
